notes.title: Magna Regna has won Vision Game award!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682843/6e4ae0a18fa78997e2b0fa6b3303f314954ca1ab.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42682843/05138ac8530f52be61aeee391b4fac4b0ab0287c.jpg[/img][/url]
We are happy to announce that we have been awarded ''Best Game'' on the Game Access Conference 2024 event. The award was given to us via Vision Game. Thank you! And we promise, we will continue our hard work to push the game forward. Our next milestone is a public demo. So keep your fingers crossed for us! We thank you that you are unrelenting in your support, despite our secretivity and slower development pace.
